notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40150796/ce8d564c63743b82500591838d8ef9f07e9c37db.jpg[/img]

Hi Villagers of Cigalo,

Thank you for your support all along the way. We've been collecting your feedback and bug reports on Steam & Discord, and we're doing our best to investigate and fix them!

🗒️ Here's the changelog:

[h2]Additions/Improvements:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added controller symbol selection setting.
[*] Improved clarity of objectives for all "Receptacle quests."
[*] Enhanced level art around the jammer in the Croaking Forest.
[/list]

[h2]Major Fixes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed save restoration issues.
[*] Fixed game freeze when opening the pause menu after making the final choice in the end sequence.
[*] Fixed "Baie quest" not marked as completed when loading a save file if vehicle parts were collected before starting the quest.
[*] Fixed "Lamarr quest" not triggering properly if the robots in the Refuge are met in the last chapter.
[*] Fixed "Curry quest" becoming unfinishable if the Nomad Door sequence isn't completed first.
[*] Fixed an issue where loading a save during the game's ending would revert progress to the point of no return.
[*] Fixed bridge button to access the wind turbine transformer top being non-interactive.
[/list]

[h2]Medium Fixes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed relays in Nefle Hub.
[*] Fixed interaction conditions with relay levers.
[*] Fixed "Lamarr quest" not closing properly if missed.
[*] Fixed the final quest thread before the ending not pointing to talking with Rose.
[/list]

[h2]Minor Fixes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed oversized text in the Station.
[*] Removed an unintended gray wall in the first room of the Station.
[*] Fixed invisible collision on a container in the Docks.
[*] Fixed all archived quest threads showing as time-limited.
[*] Changed the color of scrap objective text to black for better readability.
[*] Updated Receptacle toaster quest images to match the new relay appearance.
[/list]
